checks.text: My residence permit is for work or study, not tourism, business or family reunion.
I can produce authority-issued tax or social insurance records covering twelve continuous months in this city.
My employer's registered address is in the same city as the property I want to buy.
Neither I nor my spouse owns residential property anywhere in mainland China.
The district housing bureau has confirmed my documents list in writing.

stops.text: My permit is not work or study.
My spouse already owns a home in China.
I want to buy in a city where I do not work or study.

checks.text: I have written down how many years I will live in this city, as a number.
I know the gross yield on this unit, and I have compared it with my mortgage rate.
I have calculated the round-trip cost (8–11%) and divided it by my holding period.
I have run the rent-versus-buy comparison over my own horizon.
I can explain my reason for buying without referring to what prices might do.

stops.text: I expect to leave within three years.
I might need this money back within a year.
My main reason is that the price is likely to rise.

checks.text: I can name the district I would live in, and I have visited it at 8am on a weekday.
If I have children, the school place is confirmed or the application calendar is understood.
I know my actual door-to-door commute, not the map distance.
I know roughly how long a resale would take in this district, and who the buyer would be.
I have identified a lawyer in this city who has handled a foreign purchase recently.

stops.text: There are almost no foreign-buyer transactions in this market.

checks.text: The registered use on the title certificate is residential (住宅).
I know the land grant date, and the remaining term is at least 35 years.
I know the registered area, and whether it sits either side of the 140m² deed-tax threshold.
I know the management fee and heating cost per year as a share of price.
I have checked for heritage, planning or demolition orders on the building.

stops.text: The use is commercial or the unit is a 40/50-year loft.
Remaining land term is under 35 years.
There is a heritage or demolition order on the building.

checks.text: A registry search confirmed ownership, and no mortgages, seals or objections.
The seller's spouse will sign, and I have seen the marriage certificate.
The supervised escrow account exists, and the release conditions are written into it.
The contract refunds my deposit if eligibility or financing fails, by a stated date.
The registered price is the price I am actually paying.

stops.text: Someone asked me to pay a person rather than an account.
I was asked to register a lower price to save tax.
I am being asked to sign a contract I have not had translated.
